picks.why: Quanta posted a record AI-driven backlog (7845c599668e) and trades at 26.8x forward earnings with 57% revenue growth and a 4% free cash flow yield, 26% off its high in the one segment still rated overweight. It builds the grid and interconnection capacity that the power-constraint thesis says is scarce.
picks.risk: A Texas-style permit freeze or data-centre moratoria could slow the projects behind its backlog.

picks.why: Lam earns a 40% operating margin on 54% revenue growth and trades at 18.1x forward earnings, 50% off its high, a price that limits the downside for a toolmaker every chip expansion needs. This is the quality end of a segment that fell 32% on the month.
picks.risk: If hyperscaler capex restraint spreads, chip fab spending and equipment orders would be cut.
